inference.inheritance: Use the same source-fixed-effect + target-fixed-effect two-way source/target cluster-robust framework as Study B, requalified on Study C development geometry.
inference.fallback_after_failure: none; failed qualification is NOT_EVALUABLE_C and cannot authorize a replacement estimator or historical predictor

synthetic_worlds.seed_rule: uint64 from first 16 hex characters of SHA256('<namespace>|<opportunity_design_sha256>|<cell_name>')
synthetic_worlds.private_structure: source-specific slope on z_geographic_coverage plus target-specific slope on centered_same_order; each slope SD = 0.12*A

historical_positive_cell.name: historical_relation_A3_beta0p03
historical_positive_cell.rationale: The same standardized minimally meaningful relational-effect floor as Study B, frozen before Study B qualification.

gates.predictor_condition_number: < 1e4 after exact two-way FE absorption on development eligible dyads
gates.private_type1: Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.025 rejection rate <=0.05 for every frozen private-null cell
gates.historical_power: Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.025 rejection rate >=0.80 for historical_relation_A3_beta0p03

exact_survivor_requalification: After the confirmatory character mask, rerun this identical estimator, synthetic world family, seed namespace rule, alpha, effect floor and gates on the exact survivor dyad geometry before nucleotide identity, T_st or beta_hist may be opened.
forbidden: change beta_hist effect floor after seeing Study B qualification or any Study C external-data result
change R_hist, R_current, controls, estimator, alpha, world generator or Wilson gates after formal results
drop R_current because it is correlated with R_hist
replace failed historical qualification with ice-sheet, refugial, barrier or another historical relation
interpret qualification failure as evidence that historical climate displacement lacks a biological effect
